findings.title: AI judge: tool metadata manipulates the assistant
findings.evidence: marker: directs the assistant p=0.95, solicits or sends sensitive data p=0.95, asks for secrecy from the user p=0.95
findings.remediation: An AI judge reads this text as an attempt to manipulate the assistant. Review it by hand; treat the server as untrusted until you do.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + exfiltration path
findings.evidence: untrusted input: tickets/lookup_ticket; private data: crm/customer_records; exfiltration: partner/notify_partner
findings.remediation: Injected text read by one tool can drive the others to leak private data. Split these servers across separate agent sessions, remove one leg of the trifecta, or require human approval for every sink call.

findings.title: Untrusted input can reach code execution
findings.evidence: untrusted input: tickets/lookup_ticket; code execution: partner/shell
findings.remediation: Text an attacker controls can become a command. Sandbox the execution tool and require human approval for it, or remove the untrusted-input tool.

findings.title: Server source not found locally (RCE source scan skipped)
findings.remediation: To scan this server's code, add a "source_path" (or "cwd") pointing at its source to the config entry, or install the package locally (e.g. run the npx/uvx command once) and re-scan.

findings.title: Tool exposes a dangerous capability
findings.evidence: capabilities inferred: code execution, shell / command
findings.remediation: Confirm this tool needs this power. Apply least privilege: scope filesystem/network access, sandbox execution, and require human approval for high-impact actions.

findings.remediation: This server doesn't need this power for what it says it does. Remove or disable the tool, or require approval for every call.
